<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0" />
<title>NEXA</title>
<!-- PWA -->
<meta name="application-name" content="NEXA" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="NEXA" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#2563FF" />
<!-- フォント：Manrope（ロゴ/タイトル）+ Inter（本文） -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<!-- SVG favicon -->
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64," />
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64," />
<!-- Web App Manifest inline -->
<script>
(function(){
  const iconPng="data:image/png;base64,";
  const manifest={name:'NEXA',short_name:'NEXA',description:'NEXA – Student Operating System',start_url:'.',display:'standalone',background_color:'#eef3ff',theme_color:'#2563FF',orientation:'portrait',icons:[{src:iconPng,sizes:'192x192',type:'image/png',purpose:'any maskable'},{src:iconPng,sizes:'512x512',type:'image/png',purpose:'any maskable'}]};
  const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest)],{type:'application/json'});
  const link=document.createElement('link');link.rel='manifest';link.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  document.currentScript.parentNode.insertBefore(link,document.currentScript);
})();
</script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@latest/tabler-icons.min.css" />
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --acc:#2563FF;
  --acc2:#2563FF;
  --acc-soft:#EEF3FF;
  --bg:#F6F8FC;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;
  --border:#E4E8F0;
  --text:#0F172A;
  --muted:#64748B;
  --r:16px;
  --rsm:10px;
  --shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.06),0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
}
html,body{height:100%;background:#E8ECF4;overflow:hidden;}
body{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,'SF Pro Display',BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.app-shell{
width:100%;
max-width:430px;
height:100dvh;
max-height:100dvh;
background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;border:0.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(30,50,120,.15)}
@media(max-width:500px){.app-shell{border-radius:0;max-height:100dvh;border:none;min-height:100dvh}}

/* ⑫ iPad (768px+) */
@media(min-width:768px){
  body{background:#D8DDE8}
  .app-shell{max-width:820px;height:94dvh;max-height:94dvh;border-radius:20px}
  /* 時間割ビュー：左=グリッド 右=サイドパネル */
  #view-school{display:none;flex-direction:row;gap:0;overflow:hidden}
  #view-school.active{display:flex}
  #view-school .tt-wrap{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 16px 24px}
  .tt-school-side{width:240px;flex-shrink:0;border-left:1px solid var(--border);overflow-y:auto;padding:18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:var(--bg)}
  /* 設定画面2カラム */
  .settings-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;padding:20px 20px 32px}
  .acct-card,.acct-login-btn{grid-column:1/-1}
  .settings-card{margin-bottom:0}
  .sf-row2{flex-direction:row}
  .sf-row2>div{flex:1;min-width:0}
  /* 時間割セル拡大 */
  .tt-cell{min-height:72px}
  .tt-item{font-size:10px;padding:7px 6px 5px}
  .tt-grid{grid-template-columns:44px repeat(6,1fr);gap:5px}
  .tt-head{font-size:12px}
  .tt-time-cell .t-limit{font-size:11px}
  .tt-time-cell .t-range{font-size:8px}
}

/* PC (1200px+) */
@media(min-width:1200px){
  body{background:#D0D8E8}
  .app-shell{max-width:100%;width:100%;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;border-radius:0;border:none;box-shadow:none;}
  #view-school{overflow:hidden;max-height:calc(100dvh - 120px)}
  #view-school .tt-wrap{padding:20px 28px 32px;flex:1;overflow:auto}
  .tt-school-side{width:320px;padding:24px 22px;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .tt-grid{gap:8px;grid-template-columns:54px repeat(6,1fr);min-width:unset;width:100%}
  .tt-cell{min-height:90px}
  .tt-item{font-size:12px;padding:10px 9px 8px;border-left-width:3px}
  .tt-item-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
  .tt-item-time{font-size:10px}
  .tt-time-cell .t-limit{font-size:13px}
  .tt-time-cell .t-range{font-size:9px}
  .tt-head{font-size:14px;padding:8px 4px 14px;letter-spacing:.04em}
  /* 設定3カラム */
  .settings-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;padding:28px 32px 48px;gap:20px}
  /* topbar拡張 */
  .topbar{padding:16px 28px 0}
  .page-big{font-size:32px}
  .bottomnav{padding-left:28px;padding-right:28px;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
  /* 今日タブPC */
  #view-today{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
  .content{overflow-y:auto}
  #tt-today-card{padding:16px 20px 0;}
  .today-class-card{padding:18px 22px 20px;}
  .today-class-card-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
}
.topbar{background:var(--surface);padding:14px 18px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.topbar-head{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
align-items:center;
margin-bottom:10px;
gap:8px;
}
.page-small{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--acc);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1px}
.page-big{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;transition:opacity .22s,transform .22s;font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif}
.top-right{
display:flex;
gap:6px;
align-items:center;
flex-shrink:0;
}
.icon-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc-soft);border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--acc);font-size:18px;transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),background .22s,box-shadow .22s}
.icon-btn:hover{background:#d4e4fd;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(26,110,247,.2)}
.icon-btn:active{transform:scale(.88)}
.fab{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2));border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:white;font-size:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(26,110,247,.35);transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .26s}
.fab:hover{transform:scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(26,110,247,.45)}
.fab:active{transform:scale(.88);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,110,247,.2)}
.mode-strip{display:flex;background:var(--bg);border-radius:50px;padding:3px;margin-bottom:10px;border:0.5px solid var(--border)}
.mode-btn{flex:1;padding:5px 0;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50px;color:var(--muted);font-family:inherit;transition:background .28s,color .28s,transform .22s}
.mode-btn.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--acc);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.mode-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.week-strip{display:flex;gap:1px}
.wd{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:5px 0 10px;flex:1;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2.5px solid transparent;transition:border-color .35s}
.wd.active{border-bottom-color:var(--acc)}
.wd-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.wd.active .wd-label{color:var(--acc)}
.wd.sat .wd-label{color:#2563eb}
.wd.hol .wd-label,.wd.sun .wd-label{color:#dc2626}
.wd-num{width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;transition:background .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),color .3s,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.wd.active .wd-num{background:var(--acc);color:white;transform:scale(1.15)}
.wd.today-dot .wd-num{background:rgba(26,110,247,.13);color:var(--acc);border-radius:50%;}
.wd.sun .wd-num,.wd.hol .wd-num{color:#dc2626}
.wd.sat .wd-num{color:#2563eb}
.hol-label{font-size:8px;color:#dc2626;max-width:36px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:center}
.month-grid{padding:8px 0 12px}
.month-header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px;padding:0 2px}
.month-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px;padding:0 2px}
.mc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s,transform .22s;min-height:36px}
.mc:hover{background:var(--acc-soft)}
.mc:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.mc.active .mc-num{background:var(--acc);color:white;border-radius:50%;width:22px;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.mc.today-dot .mc-num{background:rgba(26,110,247,.13);color:var(--acc);border-radius:50%;width:22px;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.mc.other-month{opacity:.3}
.mc.hol .mc-num,.mc.sun .mc-num{color:#dc2626}
.mc.sat .mc-num{color:#2563eb}
.mc-dot{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:2px}
.bottomnav{display:flex;background:var(--surface);border-top:0.5px solid var(--border);padding:6px 4px 0;padding-bottom:calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));flex-shrink:0;min-height:calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.bnav-btn{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-family:inherit;transition:color .28s,transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.bnav-btn i{font-size:21px;padding:3px 13px;border-radius:50px;transition:background .28s,transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.bnav-btn.active{color:var(--acc)}
.bnav-btn.active i{background:var(--acc-soft);transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.08)}
.bnav-btn:active{transform:scale(.88)}
.content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--bg);position:relative}
.view{display:none}
.view.active{display:block}
.view.slide-left{animation:slideInLeft .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.view.slide-right{animation:slideInRight .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
@keyframes viewIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes slideInLeft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes slideInRight{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.timeline-wrap{padding:8px 0 12px}
.tl-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;min-height:56px}
.tl-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);padding:3px 8px 0 0;text-align:right}
.tl-track{border-top:0.5px solid var(--border);padding:4px 14px 0 10px;position:relative}
.tl-now-line{position:absolute;left:0;right:14px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ef4444,#f97316);border-radius:1px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.tl-now-dot{position:absolute;left:-4px;top:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;animation:dotPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.ev{border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .28s,opacity .22s;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06);animation:rowIn .36s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.ev:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.01);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.ev:active{transform:scale(.97);opacity:.85}
.ev-class{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eff6ff,#e8f0fe);border-left:3px solid var(--acc)}
.ev-routine{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfdf5,#d1fae5);border-left:3px solid #059669}
.ev-todo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff7ed,#fef3c7);border-left:3px solid #d97706}
.ev-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.ev-time{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.ev-class .ev-title{color:#1e40af}
.ev-routine .ev-title{color:#065f46}
.ev-todo .ev-title{color:#92400e}
.school-panel{overflow:hidden;max-height:0;transition:max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .4s;opacity:0;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);margin:0 12px 8px;border:0.5px solid #bfdbfe;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.school-panel.open{max-height:600px;opacity:1}
.school-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 12px 6px;padding:11px 14px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);border:0.5px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s}
.school-toggle:active{background:var(--acc-soft)}
.school-toggle-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.school-toggle-icon{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eff6ff,#e8f0fe);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--acc);flex-shrink:0}
.school-toggle-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.school-toggle-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
.school-toggle-arrow{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.school-toggle-arrow.open{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border)}
.sp-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.off-banner{margin:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fef2f2,#fee2e2);border:0.5px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.sec-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;padding:14px 16px 7px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);margin:0 12px 12px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:cardIn .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.card-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border);transition:background .22s,transform .22s}
.card-row:active{background:var(--acc-soft);transform:scale(.99)}
.card-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0}
.pill{font-size:11px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.pill-blue{background:#eff6ff;color:#1d4ed8}
.pill-green{background:#ecfdf5;color:#065f46}
.pill-amber{background:#fff7ed;color:#92400e}
.cd-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px;padding:0 12px 16px}
.cd-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .28s;box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:popIn .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.cd-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(26,110,247,.15)}
.cd-card:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.cd-num{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--acc)}
.cd-num.urgent{color:#DC2626}
/* ⑦ セグメントコントロール */
.today-seg-wrap{padding:12px 14px 8px;background:var(--bg)}
.today-seg{display:flex;background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.today-seg-btn{flex:1;padding:7px 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted);font-family:inherit;transition:background .15s,color .15s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.today-seg-btn.active{background:var(--acc);color:#fff;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(37,99,255,.25)}
/* ⑪ 長期休暇バナー */
.vac-banner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:8px 14px 4px;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f3e8ff,#ede9fe);border:0.5px solid #c4b5fd;border-radius:var(--r)}
.vac-banner-icon{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.vac-banner-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#5b21b6}
.vac-banner-sub{font-size:11px;color:#7c3aed;margin-top:2px}
/* ⑪ 長期休暇プリセット */
.vacation-presets{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vac-preset-btn{padding:5px 12px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:50px;background:var(--bg);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
.vac-preset-btn:hover{background:var(--acc-soft);color:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc)}
.vac-preset-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
/* ⑥ 今日の時間割カード */
.today-tt-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:4px 14px 8px;padding:13px 14px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);border:0.5px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.today-tt-card:active{background:var(--acc-soft)}
.today-tt-card-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.today-tt-card-icon{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--acc-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--acc);font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0}
.today-tt-card-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.today-tt-card-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
/* ⑧ Apple Calendar風スケジュールタイムライン */
.sch-tl-wrap{padding:16px 14px 32px}
.sch-tl-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 20px 1fr;gap:0 10px;margin-bottom:4px}
.sch-tl-time{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;padding-top:4px}
.sch-tl-start{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--acc)}
.sch-tl-end{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.sch-tl-line{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0;padding-top:8px}
.sch-tl-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sub-accent,var(--acc));flex-shrink:0;margin-bottom:3px}
.sch-tl-track-line{flex:1;width:1.5px;background:var(--border);min-height:24px}
.sch-tl-row:last-child .sch-tl-track-line{display:none}
.sch-tl-card{
  background:var(--sub-bg,var(--surface));
  border-radius:12px;padding:10px 13px 12px;
  border:0.5px solid var(--sub-border,var(--border));
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:10px;
  transition:transform .2s;
}
.sch-tl-card:hover{transform:translateX(2px);}
.sch-tl-sub{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--sub-text,var(--text));white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sch-tl-period{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub-time,var(--muted));margin-top:2px}
.tt-wrap{overflow-x:auto;padding:12px 10px 24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.tt-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:34px repeat(6,1fr);
  gap:4px;
  min-width:290px;
  font-size:10px;
}
/* ⑦ 今日の授業カード（時間割タブ最上部） */
#tt-today-card{padding:12px 12px 0;}
.today-class-card{
  background:var(--surface);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:14px 16px 16px;
  border:0.5px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.today-class-card-empty{opacity:.7}
.today-class-card-title{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.today-class-card-list{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:6px 12px;
}
.today-card-row{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;
}
.today-card-period{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
  flex-shrink:0;min-width:20px;
}
.today-card-sub{
  font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
/* ⑨ 曜日ヘッダー簡素化 */
.tt-head.tt-head-empty{background:transparent}
.tt-head{
  text-align:center;
  padding:4px 2px 10px;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--muted);
  background:transparent;
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
  position:relative;
}
.tt-head.tcol{
  color:var(--acc);font-weight:800;
  position:relative;
}
.tt-head.tcol::before{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;top:0;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:2.5px;height:calc(100% + 2px);
  background:rgba(37,99,255,.12);
  border-radius:2px;
  z-index:0;
}
.tt-head.tcol::after{
  content:'';
  display:block;
  width:5px;height:5px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--acc);
  margin:3px auto 0;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
/* ⑨ 時限ラベル */
.tt-time-cell{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-start;
  padding:6px 4px 0 0;
  gap:1px;
}
.tt-time-cell .t-limit{
  font-weight:700;font-size:9px;
  color:var(--muted);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.tt-time-cell .t-range{font-size:6.5px;color:#94A3B8;line-height:1.3}
.tt-time-cell .t-sep{display:none}
/* ⑨ セル：より大きく、空白セルはほぼ透明 */
.tt-cell{
  background:transparent;
  border-radius:8px;
  min-height:62px;
  padding:2px;
  position:relative;
}
/* ⑨ 今日列：極薄ブルー背景 */
.tt-cell.tcol{background:rgba(37,99,255,.05);border-radius:8px;}
.tt-cell.tcol .tt-item{background:#E8F0FF;border-left-color:#2563FF;}
.tt-cell.off{opacity:.3}
/* ⑨ 授業カード：よりクリーンなミニマルデザイン */
/* ⑭ カラーシステム：カード全体着色 */
.tt-item{
  background:var(--sub-bg,#EFF5FF);
  border-radius:8px;
  padding:7px 6px 6px;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:600;
  overflow:hidden;
  cursor:pointer;
  height:100%;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:3px;
  border:none;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sub-border,rgba(37,99,255,.18)),
             0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
  transition:opacity .15s,transform .12s;
}
.tt-item:hover{opacity:.84;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--sub-accent,#2563FF),0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.tt-item:active{transform:scale(.95);opacity:.7}
/* 科目名行 */
.tt-item-name{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--sub-text,#0f172a);
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
  width:100%;line-height:1.3;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
/* 時刻行 */
.tt-item-time{
  font-size:7.5px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--sub-time,var(--muted));
  white-space:nowrap;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;
}
.settings-wrap{padding:12px 12px 24px}
.settings-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);border:0.5px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:16px;overflow:hidden;animation:cardIn .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.settings-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.04s}
.settings-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}
.settings-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.16s}
.settings-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.22s}
.settings-card-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface)}
.settings-card-header i{font-size:18px;color:var(--acc)}
.settings-card-header-text{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
.settings-card-body{padding:14px 16px}
.sf-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px;margin-top:10px;display:block}
.sf-label:first-child{margin-top:0}
.sf-input{width:100%;font-size:13px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;min-height:42px;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none}
.sf-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,255,.10)}
/* ① ② フォーム2列：スマホは縦積み、広い画面のみ横並び */
.sf-row2{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
@media(min-width:480px){.sf-row2{flex-direction:row;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}}
@media(min-width:480px){.sf-row2>div{flex:1;min-width:0}}
/* ④ サイドパネル（iPad以上のみ表示） */
@media(min-width:768px){#tt-school-side{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}}
.tt-side-sec{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:6px}
.tt-side-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tt-side-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.tt-side-period{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--acc);width:22px;flex-shrink:0;padding-top:1px}
.tt-side-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tt-side-sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tt-side-time{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
.tt-side-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 0;opacity:.7}
.sf-row2>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.sf-input[type="date"],.sf-input[type="time"],.sf-input[type="number"]{min-width:0;width:100%}
.sf-btn{width:100%;margin-top:12px;padding:11px;background:#2563FF;color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .2s,background .15s;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,255,.22);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.sf-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(37,99,255,.35);transform:translateY(-1px);background:#1d4ed8}
.sf-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.day-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:5px;margin-bottom:10px}
.day-btn{padding:7px 2px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s,transform .12s;font-family:inherit;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.day-btn.sel{background:var(--acc);color:white;border-color:var(--acc)}
.day-btn:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.period-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:5px;margin-bottom:10px}
.period-btn{padding:8px 4px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,transform .12s;font-family:inherit;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.period-btn.sel{background:#eff6ff;border-color:var(--acc)}
.period-btn:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.period-btn .pb-limit{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
.period-btn.sel .pb-limit{color:var(--acc)}
.period-btn .pb-time{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}
.reg-list{margin-top:10px}
.reg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border);animation:rowIn .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;transition:opacity .22s,transform .22s}
.reg-item.removing{animation:shrinkOut .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
.reg-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.del-btn{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border:0.5px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:50px;background:none;color:#b91c1c;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:transform .18s,background .18s,color .18s;flex-shrink:0}
.del-btn:hover{background:#fef2f2;border-color:#ef4444}
.del-btn:active{transform:scale(.92)}
.sf-accordion-wrap{margin-top:12px}
.sf-accordion-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--bg);border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .15s,color .15s;text-align:left}
.sf-accordion-btn:hover{background:#eef0f6;color:var(--text)}
.sf-accordion-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.sf-acc-arrow{transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.sf-accordion-btn.open .sf-acc-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sf-accordion-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .3s}
.sf-accordion-body.open{max-height:800px}
.empty-reg{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:12px 0}
.drawer-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.4);align-items:flex-end;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:100}
.drawer-overlay.open{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .28s ease}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes popIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.85) translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes cardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes rowIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes shrinkOut{to{opacity:0;transform:scaleY(0) translateY(-6px);max-height:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}}
@keyframes dotPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.4)}}
@keyframes shimmer{from{background-position:200% 0}to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.drawer{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r) var(--r) 0 0;padding:20px;width:100%;max-width:430px;margin:0 auto;animation:drawerUp .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
@keyframes drawerUp{from{transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.drawer-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--text)}
.dw-input{width:100%;font-size:14px;padding:11px 14px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;margin-bottom:10px}
.dw-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,110,247,.12)}
.dw-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}
.dw-cancel{flex:1;padding:11px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:50px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.dw-submit{flex:2;padding:11px;background:#2563FF;color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,255,.22);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),background .15s}
.dw-submit:hover{background:#1d4ed8;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.dw-submit:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.print-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:0 12px 16px;padding:13px 18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e293b);color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.25);width:calc(100% - 24px);transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .26s}
.print-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
.print-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:36px 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
@media print{

  @page{
    size:A4;
    margin:12mm;
  }

  html,body{
    width:100%;
    background:white;
    overflow:visible!important;
  }

  body{
    display:block!important;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
  }

  .app-shell,
  .topbar,
  .bottomnav,
  .content{
    display:none!important;
  }

  #print-area{
    display:block!important;
    position:static!important;
    width:100%;
    max-width:none!important;
    min-height:auto;
    padding:0;
    margin:0 auto;
    font-family:sans-serif;
    color:#000;
    font-size:14px;
    zoom:1;
  }

  .print-header{
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }

  .print-section{
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }

  .print-row{
    padding:10px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
  }
  .print-row:last-child{
    border-bottom:none;
  }
  .print-period-label{
    font-size:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#555;
    margin-bottom:3px;
  }
  .print-time{
    font-size:12px;
    color:#777;
    margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .print-subject{
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#111;
  }
  .print-routine-row,
  .print-task-row{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:2px;
    padding:8px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
  }
  .print-routine-row:last-child,
  .print-task-row:last-child{
    border-bottom:none;
  }
  .print-routine-time{
    font-size:11px;
    color:#777;
  }
  .print-routine-name{
    font-size:14px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#111;
  }
  .print-routine-dur{
    font-size:11px;
    color:#999;
  }
  .print-section h3{
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#333;
    margin-bottom:8px;
    padding-bottom:4px;
    border-bottom:2px solid #ddd;
  }
}
.confirm-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.45);align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);z-index:200;padding:20px}
.confirm-overlay.open{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .28s ease}
.confirm-modal{background:var(--surface);border-radius:22px;padding:24px 20px 18px;width:100%;max-width:320px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.2);animation:modalUp .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
@keyframes modalUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.cm-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fef2f2,#fee2e2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;margin:0 auto 14px}
.cm-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:6px}
.cm-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:18px}
.cm-btns{display:flex;gap:8px}
.cm-cancel{flex:1;padding:12px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:50px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);transition:background .22s}
.cm-cancel:active{background:var(--bg)}
.cm-del{flex:1;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626);color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(239,68,68,.3);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.cm-del:active{transform:scale(.96)}
/* ── Auth Modal ─────────────────────── */
.auth-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.5);align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:300;padding:20px}
.auth-overlay.open{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .28s ease}
.auth-modal{background:var(--surface);border-radius:24px;padding:28px 22px 22px;width:100%;max-width:340px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(15,23,42,.22);animation:modalUp .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.auth-logo{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;margin:0 auto 16px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(26,110,247,.3)}
.auth-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px;font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.3px}
.auth-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.auth-tabs{display:flex;background:var(--bg);border-radius:50px;padding:3px;margin-bottom:18px;border:0.5px solid var(--border)}
.auth-tab{flex:1;padding:7px 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50px;color:var(--muted);font-family:inherit;transition:background .22s,color .22s}
.auth-tab.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--acc);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.auth-input{width:100%;font-size:14px;padding:11px 14px;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .22s,box-shadow .22s;margin-bottom:10px}
.auth-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,110,247,.12)}
.auth-btn{width:100%;padding:13px;background:#2563FF;color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,255,.25);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .2s,background .15s;margin-top:4px}
.auth-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(37,99,255,.35);background:#1d4ed8}
.auth-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.auth-btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default;transform:none}
.auth-err{font-size:12px;color:#dc2626;text-align:center;margin-top:8px;min-height:18px;animation:popIn .22s ease}
/* ── Account card in Settings ───────── */
.acct-card{background:#2563FF;border-radius:var(--r);margin:0 0 16px;padding:18px;color:white;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(37,99,255,.25);animation:cardIn .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.acct-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px}
.acct-email{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px;opacity:.95}
.acct-status{font-size:11px;opacity:.75;margin-bottom:14px}
.acct-btns{display:flex;gap:8px}
.acct-sync-btn{flex:2;padding:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:50px;color:white;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.acct-sync-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.acct-sync-btn.syncing i{animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.acct-out-btn{flex:1;padding:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:50px;color:white;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s}
.acct-out-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.acct-login-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r);border:0.5px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s;margin:0 0 16px;animation:cardIn .44s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.acct-login-btn:active{background:var(--acc-soft)}
.auth-modal{position:relative}
.auth-close-btn{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:0.5px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.auth-close-btn:hover{background:var(--border);color:var(--text)}
.auth-close-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
/* 確認メール送信後パネル */
.auth-sent{display:none;text-align:center;animation:popIn .38s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.auth-sent.visible{display:block}
.auth-sent-icon{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfdf5,#d1fae5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;margin:0 auto 16px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.auth-sent-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:8px}
.auth-sent-body{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px}
.auth-sent-email{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--acc);background:var(--acc-soft);border-radius:50px;padding:3px 12px;margin:0 0 6px}
.auth-sent-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-direction:column}
.auth-sent-open{padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2));color:white;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(26,110,247,.3);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .22s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.auth-sent-open:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(26,110,247,.4)}
.auth-sent-close{width:100%;padding:11px;background:none;border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .22s}
.auth-sent-close:active{background:var(--bg)}
.sync-badge{font-size:11px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:600}
.sync-ok{background:#ecfdf5;color:#065f46}
.sync-off{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
/* ── メールアプリ誘導ボタン ── */
.auth-sent-apps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;width:100%}
.auth-app-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg);border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,transform .18s;text-align:left}
.auth-app-btn:hover{background:var(--acc-soft);border-color:var(--acc)}
.auth-app-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.auth-app-icon{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ea4335,#fbbc04);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:white;flex-shrink:0}
.auth-sent-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px}

/* === NEXA Splash Screen === */
#nexa-splash{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8faff 0%,#eef3ff 60%,#e6edff 100%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:0;
  animation:splashFadeIn .35s ease both;
  pointer-events:all;
}
#nexa-splash.fade-out{
  animation:splashFadeOut .5s ease forwards;
}
@keyframes splashFadeIn{
  from{opacity:0}
  to{opacity:1}
}
@keyframes splashFadeOut{
  from{opacity:1;transform:none}
  to{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.015)}
}
.splash-logo-wrap{
  width:min(160px,38vw);
  height:min(160px,38vw);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:28px;
}
.splash-logo-wrap img{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  border-radius:28%;
  box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(37,99,255,.18),0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,255,.10);
}
.splash-brand{
  font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(32px,8vw,44px);
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
  color:#0f172a;
  line-height:1;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.splash-brand .splash-x{
  color:#2563FF;
  font-weight:800;
}
.splash-dots{
  font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(10px,2.5vw,13px);
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.45em;
  color:#64748b;
  margin-bottom:16px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.splash-tagline{
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(10px,2.2vw,12px);
  font-weight:400;
  color:#94a3b8;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
  text-align:center;
  max-width:280px;
  line-height:1.5;
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="nexa-splash">
  <div class="splash-logo-wrap">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="NEXA" />
  </div>
  <div class="splash-brand">NE<span class="splash-x">X</span>A</div>
  <div class="splash-dots">N · E · X · A</div>
  <div class="splash-tagline">Next Edition eXperience<br>for Academic Life</div>
</div>

<div class="app-shell">
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-head">
      <div>
        <div class="page-small" id="page-small">今日</div>
        <div class="page-big" id="page-big"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="top-right">
        <button class="icon-btn" onclick="prevPeriod()" aria-label="前へ"><i class="ti ti-chevron-left"></i></button>
        <button class="icon-btn" onclick="nextPeriod()" aria-label="次へ"><i class="ti ti-chevron-right"></i></button>
        <button class="icon-btn" onclick="doPrint()" aria-label="印刷"><i class="ti ti-printer"></i></button>
        <button class="fab" onclick="openDrawer()" aria-label="タスク追加"><i class="ti ti-plus"></i></button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mode-strip">
      <button class="mode-btn active" onclick="setMode('week')" id="mode-week">週</button>
      <button class="mode-btn" onclick="setMode('month')" id="mode-month">月</button>
    </div>
    <div id="cal-area"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="content">
    <div class="view active" id="view-today"><div id="today-inner"></div></div>
    <div class="view" id="view-school">
      <div class="sec-title" style="font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.2px">時間割</div>
      <div class="tt-wrap"><div class="tt-grid" id="tt-grid"></div></div>
      <div class="tt-school-side" id="tt-school-side" style="display:none"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="view" id="view-routine"><div class="sec-title">毎日のルーティーン</div><div class="card" id="routine-card"></div></div>
    <div class="view" id="view-task"><div class="sec-title">タスク一覧</div><div class="card" id="task-card"></div></div>
    <div class="view" id="view-settings"><div class="settings-wrap" id="settings-inner"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="bottomnav">
    <button class="bnav-btn active" onclick="setTab('today','',0)" id="bnav-today"><i class="ti ti-calendar-event"></i>今日</button>
    <button class="bnav-btn" onclick="setTab('school','時間割',1)" id="bnav-school"><i class="ti ti-school"></i>時間割</button>
    <button class="bnav-btn" onclick="setTab('routine','ルーティーン',2)" id="bnav-routine"><i class="ti ti-refresh"></i>ルーティーン</button>
    <button class="bnav-btn" onclick="setTab('task','タスク',3)" id="bnav-task"><i class="ti ti-checkbox"></i>タスク</button>
    <button class="bnav-btn" onclick="setTab('settings','設定',4)" id="bnav-settings"><i class="ti ti-settings"></i>設定</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="drawer-overlay" id="drawer-overlay" onclick="closeBg(event)">
  <div class="drawer">
    <div class="drawer-title">タスクを追加</div>
    <label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600">内容</label>
    <input class="dw-input" type="text" id="dw-text" placeholder="例: 数学 練習問題 p.32" />
    <label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600">時刻</label>
    <input class="dw-input" type="time" id="dw-time" value="18:00" />
    <div class="dw-row">
      <button class="dw-cancel" onclick="closeDrawer()">キャンセル</button>
      <button class="dw-submit" onclick="addTaskD()">追加する</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="print-area" style="display:none"></div>

<div class="confirm-overlay" id="confirm-overlay" onclick="closeBgConfirm(event)">
  <div class="confirm-modal">
    <div class="cm-icon">🗑️</div>
    <div class="cm-title" id="cm-title">授業を削除しますか？</div>
    <div class="cm-sub" id="cm-sub"></div>
    <div class="cm-btns">
      <button class="cm-cancel" onclick="closeConfirm()">キャンセル</button>
      <button class="cm-del" id="cm-del-btn" onclick="confirmDelClass()">削除する</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Auth Modal -->
<div class="auth-overlay" id="auth-overlay" onclick="closeBgAuth(event)">
  <div class="auth-modal">
    <button class="auth-close-btn" onclick="closeAuth()" aria-label="閉じる"><i class="ti ti-x"></i></button>
    <!-- 通常フォーム -->
    <div id="auth-form-body">
      <div class="auth-logo"><svg viewBox="0 0 52 52" width="52" height="52" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="ag" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a6ef7"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5b4ef8"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="52" height="52" rx="16" fill="url(#ag)"/><text x="26" y="35" font-family="Manrope,system-ui" font-weight="800" font-size="19" fill="white" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="-0.5">NEXA</text></svg></div>
      <div class="auth-title">NEXA</div>
      <div class="auth-sub">アカウントでデータをデバイス間同期</div>
      <div class="auth-tabs">
        <button class="auth-tab active" id="auth-tab-login" onclick="switchAuthTab('login')">ログイン</button>
        <button class="auth-tab" id="auth-tab-signup" onclick="switchAuthTab('signup')">新規登録</button>
      </div>
      <input class="auth-input" type="email" id="auth-email" placeholder="メールアドレス" autocomplete="email"/>
      <input class="auth-input" type="password" id="auth-password" placeholder="パスワード（6文字以上）" autocomplete="current-password"/>
      <button class="auth-btn" id="auth-submit-btn" onclick="doAuth()">ログイン</button>
      <div class="auth-err" id="auth-err"></div>
      <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:8px">
        <button id="auth-forgot-btn" onclick="showResetForm()" style="background:none;border:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;font-family:inherit">パスワードを忘れた場合</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- 確認メール送信後パネル -->
    <div class="auth-sent" id="auth-sent-panel">
      <div class="auth-sent-icon">✉️</div>
      <div class="auth-sent-title">メールを送信しました</div>
      <div class="auth-sent-body">
        <span class="auth-sent-email" id="auth-sent-email-label"></span>
        宛にメールをお送りしました。<br>受信トレイを確認し、メール内のリンクを開いてください。
      </div>
      <div class="auth-sent-apps" id="auth-sent-apps">
        <button class="auth-app-btn" onclick="openGmail()">
          <span class="auth-app-icon">G</span>
          <span>Gmailを開く</span>
          <i class="ti ti-chevron-right" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)"></i>
        </button>
        <button class="auth-app-btn" onclick="openAppleMail()">
          <span class="auth-app-icon" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#06b6d4)">✉</span>
          <span>iOSメールを開く</span>
          <i class="ti ti-chevron-right" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="auth-sent-hint">迷惑メールフォルダもご確認ください</div>
      <button class="auth-sent-close" onclick="closeAuth()">閉じる</button>
    </div>
    <!-- パスワードリセット パネル -->
    <div class="auth-sent" id="auth-reset-panel">
      <div class="auth-sent-icon">🔑</div>
      <div class="auth-sent-title" id="auth-reset-title">パスワードをリセット</div>
      <div class="auth-sent-body" id="auth-reset-body">メールアドレスを入力してください。リセットリンクを送信します。</div>
      <input class="auth-input" type="email" id="auth-reset-email" placeholder="メールアドレス" autocomplete="email" style="margin-bottom:8px"/>
      <div id="auth-reset-newpw-wrap" style="display:none">
        <input class="auth-input" type="password" id="auth-reset-newpw" placeholder="新しいパスワード（6文字以上）" style="margin-bottom:8px"/>
      </div>
      <button class="auth-btn" id="auth-reset-btn" onclick="doReset()">送信する</button>
      <div class="auth-err" id="auth-reset-err"></div>
      <button class="auth-sent-close" onclick="closeAuth()" style="margin-top:10px">閉じる</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const PERIODS=[
  {l:'1限',s:'08:40',e:'09:25'},{l:'2限',s:'09:35',e:'10:20'},
  {l:'3限',s:'10:30',e:'11:15'},{l:'4限',s:'11:25',e:'12:10'},
  {l:'5限',s:'12:55',e:'13:40'},{l:'6限',s:'13:50',e:'14:35'},
  {l:'7限',s:'14:45',e:'15:30'},
];
const SAT_MAX=4;
const DN=['日','月','火','水','木','金','土'];
const DAYS_WD=[{d:1,l:'月'},{d:2,l:'火'},{d:3,l:'水'},{d:4,l:'木'},{d:5,l:'金'},{d:6,l:'土'}];
const JP_HOL={
  '2025-01-01':'元日','2025-01-13':'成人の日','2025-02-11':'建国記念の日','2025-02-23':'天皇誕生日','2025-02-24':'振替休日','2025-03-20':'春分の日','2025-04-29':'昭和の日','2025-05-03':'憲法記念日','2025-05-04':'みどりの日','2025-05-05':'こどもの日','2025-05-06':'振替休日','2025-07-21':'海の日','2025-08-11':'山の日','2025-09-15':'敬老の日','2025-09-23':'秋分の日','2025-10-13':'スポーツの日','2025-11-03':'文化の日','2025-11-23':'勤労感謝の日','2025-11-24':'振替休日','2025-12-23':'天皇誕生日',
  '2026-01-01':'元日','2026-01-12':'成人の日','2026-02-11':'建国記念の日','2026-02-23':'天皇誕生日','2026-03-20':'春分の日','2026-04-29':'昭和の日','2026-05-03':'憲法記念日','2026-05-04':'みどりの日','2026-05-05':'こどもの日','2026-05-06':'振替休日','2026-07-20':'海の日','2026-08-11':'山の日','2026-09-21':'敬老の日','2026-09-22':'国民の休日','2026-09-23':'秋分の日','2026-10-12':'スポーツの日','2026-11-03':'文化の日','2026-11-23':'勤労感謝の日'
};

// ── Supabase 設定 ─────────────────────────────────────────
// ▼ ご自身のSupabaseプロジェクトURLとanon keyに置き換えてください
const SUPA_URL = 'https://ymuemcvdatfblrzzrgyc.supabase.co';
const SUPA_ANON = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InltdWVtY3ZkYXRmYmxyenpyZ3ljIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzk3MTA3MjQsImV4cCI6MjA5NTI4NjcyNH0.HnEHYmdDfVNYTFsyeFrjvbIpYrZpbO-s6pCd2x1JGv0'; // SupabaseダッシュボードのSettings→API→anon keyを貼る
let _sb = null;
try {
  _sb = supabase.createClient(SUPA_URL, SUPA_ANON, {
    auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true }
  });
} catch(e) { console.warn('Supabase init failed (placeholder keys):', e.message); }

let _sbUser = null; // ログイン中ユーザー
let _authTab = 'login';

// ── Auth UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function openAuth(){ const ov=document.getElementById('auth-overlay');ov.style.display='flex';requestAnimationFrame(()=>ov.classList.add('open')); }
function closeAuth(){
  const ov=document.getElementById('auth-overlay');
  ov.style.opacity='0';
  setTimeout(()=>{
    ov.style.display='none';ov.style.opacity='';ov.classList.remove('open');
    // フォームをリセット
    document.getElementById('auth-form-body').style.display='';
    document.getElementById('auth-sent-panel').classList.remove('visible');
  },250);
}
function closeBgAuth(e){if(e.target===document.getElementById('auth-overlay'))closeAuth();}
function openGmail(){
  const ua=navigator.userAgent;
  if(/Android/i.test(ua)){
    // AndroidのGmailアプリスキームを試みる
    const t=setTimeout(()=>window.open('https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#inbox','_blank','noopener'),600);
    window.location.href='googlegmail://';
    window.addEventListener('blur',()=>clearTimeout(t),{once:true});
  } else {
    window.open('https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#inbox','_blank','noopener');
  }
}
function openAppleMail(){
  // iOS Mail.app を開く（mailto: ではなく message:// スキームを使用）
  window.location.href='message://';
}
function switchAuthTab(tab){
  _authTab=tab;
  document.getElementById('auth-tab-login').classList.toggle('active',tab==='login');
  document.getElementById('auth-tab-signup').classList.toggle('active',tab==='signup');
  document.getElementById('auth-submit-btn').textContent=tab==='login'?'ログイン':'アカウントを作成';
  document.getElementById('auth-err').textContent='';
}
async function doAuth(){
  if(!_sb){document.getElementById('auth-err').textContent='Supabaseの設定が必要です（README参照）';return;}
  const email=document.getElementById('auth-email').value.trim();
  const password=document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
  const btn=document.getElementById('auth-submit-btn');
  if(!email||!password){document.getElementById('auth-err').textContent='メールとパスワードを入力してください';return;}
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='処理中...';
  document.getElementById('auth-err').textContent='';
  let err;
  if(_authTab==='login'){
    ({error:err}=await _sb.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password}));
  } else {
    ({error:err}=await _sb.auth.signUp({email,password,options:{emailRedirectTo:window.location.origin+window.location.pathname}}));
  }
  btn.disabled=false;
  switchAuthTab(_authTab);
  if(err){document.getElementById('auth-err').textContent=_authErrMsg(err.message);return;}
  if(_authTab==='signup'){
    // 送信後UIに切り替え
    document.getElementById('auth-sent-email-label').textContent=email;
    document.getElementById('auth-form-body').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('auth-sent-panel').classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }
  closeAuth();
}
function _authErrMsg(m){
  if(m.includes('Invalid login'))return 'メールまたはパスワードが違います';
  if(m.includes('Email not confirmed'))return 'メールアドレスを確認してください';
  if(m.includes('already registered'))return 'このメールアドレスはすでに登録済みです';
  if(m.includes('Password should'))return 'パスワードは6文字以上にしてください';
  return m;
}
async function doLogout(){
  if(!_sb)return;
  await _sb.auth.signOut();
  _sbUser=null;
  if(currentTab==='settings')buildSettings();
}

// ── Supabase データ同期 ─────────────────────────────────────
async function syncToCloud(){
  if(!_sbUser||!_sb)return {ok:false,msg:'未ログイン'};
  const uid=_sbUser.id;
  const payload={
    user_id:uid, classes:JSON.stringify(classes), routines:JSON.stringify(routines),
    tasks:JSON.stringify(tasks), tests:JSON.stringify(tests), holidays:JSON.stringify(holidays),
    updated_at:new Date().toISOString()
  };
  const {error}=await _sb.from('planner_data').upsert(payload,{onConflict:'user_id'});
  if(error){console.error('[NEXA sync] upsert error:',error.code,error.message,error.details);}
  return {ok:!error, msg:error?`${error.code}: ${error.message}`:null};
}
async function syncFromCloud(){
  if(!_sbUser||!_sb)return false;
  const {data,error}=await _sb.from('planner_data').select('*').eq('user_id',_sbUser.id).single();
  if(error){console.error('[NEXA sync] select error:',error.code,error.message);return false;}
  if(!data)return false;
  try{
    classes=JSON.parse(data.classes||'[]');
    routines=JSON.parse(data.routines||'[]');
    tasks=JSON.parse(data.tasks||'[]');
    tests=JSON.parse(data.tests||'[]');
    holidays=JSON.parse(data.holidays||'[]');
    sv(); // ローカルにも保存
    if(currentTab==='today')buildToday();
    else if(currentTab==='school')buildTT();
    else if(currentTab==='routine')buildRoutineList();
    else if(currentTab==='task')buildTaskList();
    updateCal();
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.error('[NEXA sync] parse error:',e);return false;}
}
async function doSync(){
  const btn=document.querySelector('.acct-sync-btn');
  if(btn){btn.classList.add('syncing');}
  const {ok,msg}=await syncToCloud();
  if(btn){
    btn.classList.remove('syncing');
    btn.querySelector('span').textContent=ok?'同期完了':'同期失敗';
    if(!ok&&msg){
      const statusEl=document.querySelector('.acct-status');
      if(statusEl){const prev=statusEl.innerHTML;statusEl.innerHTML=`<span style="color:#fca5a5;font-size:10px">${msg}</span>`;setTimeout(()=>{statusEl.innerHTML=prev;},5000);}
    }
  }
  setTimeout(()=>{if(btn)btn.querySelector('span').textContent='クラウド同期';},2000);
}

// ── ログイン状態の購読 ─────────────────────────────────────
async function initAuth(){
  if(!_sb)return;
  const code=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('code');
  if(code){
    await _sb.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    window.history.replaceState({},'',window.location.pathname);
  }
  const {data:{session}}=await _sb.auth.getSession();
  if(session){_sbUser=session.user;await syncFromCloud();}
  _sb.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event,session)=>{
    _sbUser=session?.user||null;
    if(_event==='PASSWORD_RECOVERY'){showNewPasswordForm();return;}
    if(_sbUser)syncFromCloud();
    if(currentTab==='settings')buildSettings();
  });
}

function showResetForm(){
  document.getElementById('auth-form-body').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('auth-sent-panel').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-newpw-wrap').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-email').style.display='';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-title').textContent='パスワードをリセット';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-body').textContent='メールアドレスを入力してください。リセットリンクを送信します。';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-btn').textContent='送信する';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-err').textContent='';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-panel').classList.add('visible');
  const ov=document.getElementById('auth-overlay');ov.style.display='flex';requestAnimationFrame(()=>ov.classList.add('open'));
}
function showNewPasswordForm(){
  document.getElementById('auth-form-body').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('auth-sent-panel').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-email').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-newpw-wrap').style.display='';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-title').textContent='新しいパスワードを設定';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-body').textContent='新しいパスワードを入力してください。';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-btn').textContent='パスワードを変更する';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-err').textContent='';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-panel').classList.add('visible');
  const ov=document.getElementById('auth-overlay');ov.style.display='flex';requestAnimationFrame(()=>ov.classList.add('open'));
}
async function doReset(){
  if(!_sb)return;
  const btn=document.getElementById('auth-reset-btn');
  const errEl=document.getElementById('auth-reset-err');
  errEl.textContent='';
  // 新パスワード設定モード
  if(document.getElementById('auth-reset-newpw-wrap').style.display!=='none'){
    const pw=document.getElementById('auth-reset-newpw').value;
    if(!pw||pw.length<6){errEl.textContent='パスワードは6文字以上にしてください';return;}
    btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='処理中...';
    const {error}=await _sb.auth.updateUser({password:pw});
    btn.disabled=false;
    if(error){errEl.textContent=error.message;btn.textContent='パスワードを変更する';return;}
    document.getElementById('auth-reset-title').textContent='変更完了';
    document.getElementById('auth-reset-body').textContent='パスワードを変更しました。このまま続けて利用できます。';
    document.getElementById('auth-reset-newpw-wrap').style.display='none';
    btn.style.display='none';
    return;
  }
  // メール送信モード
  const email=document.getElementById('auth-reset-email').value.trim();
  if(!email){errEl.textContent='メールアドレスを入力してください';return;}
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='送信中...';
  const {error}=await _sb.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email,{redirectTo:window.location.origin+window.location.pathname});
  btn.disabled=false;
  if(error){errEl.textContent=error.message;btn.textContent='送信する';return;}
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-title').textContent='メールを送信しました';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-body').textContent='受信トレイを確認し、リンクを開いてください。迷惑メールフォルダもご確認ください。';
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-email').style.display='none';
  btn.style.display='none';
}

// ── sv() をクラウド同期対応に上書き ───────────────────────

let classes=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sp_cl')||'[]');
let routines=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sp_rt')||'[]');
let tasks=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sp_tk')||'[]');

let holidays=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sp_hol')||'[]');
let vacations=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sp_vac')||'[]');
let sfDay=1,sfPeriod=0;

// ================================================================
// ⑭ NEXA Subject Color System
// ================================================================
const SUBJECT_COLORS = {
  math:    { bg:'#EFF6FF', border:'rgba(59,130,246,.22)',  accent:'#2563EB', text:'#1e3a8a', time:'#3b82f6' },
  english: { bg:'#F5F3FF', border:'rgba(124,58,237,.20)',  accent:'#7c3aed', text:'#3b0764', time:'#8b5cf6' },
  japanese:{ bg:'#FFF7ED', border:'rgba(234,88,12,.20)',   accent:'#ea580c', text:'#7c2d12', time:'#f97316' },
  science: { bg:'#F0FDF4', border:'rgba(22,163,74,.20)',   accent:'#16a34a', text:'#14532d', time:'#22c55e' },
  social:  { bg:'#FFFBEB', border:'rgba(217,119,6,.22)',   accent:'#d97706', text:'#78350f', time:'#f59e0b' },
  info:    { bg:'#ECFEFF', border:'rgba(8,145,178,.20)',   accent:'#0891b2', text:'#164e63', time:'#06b6d4' },
  art:     { bg:'#FDF2F8', border:'rgba(219,39,119,.18)',  accent:'#db2777', text:'#831843', time:'#ec4899' },
  pe:      { bg:'#FFF1F2', border:'rgba(225,29,72,.20)',   accent:'#e11d48', text:'#881337', time:'#f43f5e' },
  home:    { bg:'#FFF5F0', border:'rgba(251,113,133,.25)', accent:'#fb7185', text:'#9f1239', time:'#fda4af' },

  default: { bg:'#F6F8FC', border:'rgba(100,116,139,.15)', accent:'#475569', text:'#1e293b', time:'#94a3b8' },
};

// キーワード→カテゴリ ルール
const SUBJECT_RULES = [
  { cat:'math',    words:['数学','算数','数II','数III','数A','数B','数C','統計','微分','積分','線形','代数','ベクトル'] },
  { cat:'english', words:['英語','英会話','英文','リーディング','ライティング','リスニング','スピーキング','コミュニケーション英','論理表現','英表','英語表現'] },
  { cat:'japanese',words:['国語','現代文','現代の国語','言語文化','古典','古文','漢文','小論','論理国語','文学国語','現国','古典探究'] },
  { cat:'science', words:['理科','物理','化学','生物','地学','科学','実験'] },
  { cat:'social',  words:['社会','歴史','地理','公民','政治','経済','公共','倫理','日本史','世界史','地理探究','地歴','現社'] },
  { cat:'info',    words:['情報','プログラム','コンピュータ','ICT','データ','AI','DX','情報I','情報II'] },
  { cat:'art',     words:['美術','芸術','音楽','書道','工芸','デザイン','アート','図工','鑑賞'] },
  { cat:'pe',      words:['体育','保健体育','スポーツ','武道','ダンス','体操','保健'] },
  { cat:'home',    words:['家庭','家庭基礎','家庭総合','調理','被服','家政','生活','フードデザイン'] },
  { cat:'inquiry', words:['探究','総合','プロジェクト','課題研究','探究学習','ゼミ','卒業研究','SSH','SGH'] },
  { cat:'hr',      words:['ホームルーム','HR','進路','LHR','学活','朝礼','終礼','ガイダンス','キャリア'] },
];

// ユーザーカスタム（将来的にlocalStorageで永続化）
let subjectColorOverrides = {};
try { subjectColorOverrides = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nexa_sub_colors') || '{}'); } catch(e) {}

// ハッシュベース安定色生成（カテゴリ不明科目用）
function _hashColor(str) {
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) h = Math.imul(31, h) + str.charCodeAt(i) | 0;
  const palette = [
    { bg:'#EFF6FF', border:'rgba(59,130,246,.20)',  accent:'#3b82f6', text:'#1e3a8a', time:'#60a5fa' },
    { bg:'#F5F3FF', border:'rgba(124,58,237,.18)',  accent:'#7c3aed', text:'#3b0764', time:'#a78bfa' },
    { bg:'#FFF7ED', border:'rgba(234,88,12,.18)',   accent:'#ea580c', text:'#7c2d12', time:'#fb923c' },
    { bg:'#F0FDF4', border:'rgba(22,163,74,.18)',   accent:'#16a34a', text:'#14532d', time:'#4ade80' },
    { bg:'#FFFBEB', border:'rgba(217,119,6,.18)',   accent:'#d97706', text:'#78350f', time:'#fbbf24' },
    { bg:'#ECFEFF', border:'rgba(8,145,178,.18)',   accent:'#0891b2', text:'#164e63', time:'#22d3ee' },
    { bg:'#FDF2F8', border:'rgba(219,39,119,.15)',  accent:'#db2777', text:'#831843', time:'#f472b6' },
    { bg:'#FFF1F2', border:'rgba(225,29,72,.16)',   accent:'#e11d48', text:'#881337', time:'#fb7185' },
    { bg:'#EEF2FF', border:'rgba(99,102,241,.18)',  accent:'#6366f1', text:'#312e81', time:'#a5b4fc' },
    { bg:'#F0FDFA', border:'rgba(13,148,136,.18)',  accent:'#0d9488', text:'#134e4a', time:'#2dd4bf' },
    { bg:'#FFF5F0', border:'rgba(251,113,133,.22)', accent:'#fb7185', text:'#9f1239', time:'#fda4af' },
    { bg:'#F8FAFC', border:'rgba(100,116,139,.15)', accent:'#64748b', text:'#1e293b', time:'#94a3b8' },
  ];
  return palette[Math.abs(h) % palette.length];
}

// メイン：科目名→カラートークン
function getSubjectColor(subName) {
  if (!subName) return SUBJECT_COLORS.default;
  if (subjectColorOverrides[subName]) {
    return SUBJECT_COLORS[subjectColorOverrides[subName]] || SUBJECT_COLORS.default;
  }
  for (const rule of SUBJECT_RULES) {
    if (rule.words.some(w => subName.includes(w))) return SUBJECT_COLORS[rule.cat];
  }
  return _hashColor(subName);
}

// CSS変数文字列生成
function subColorStyle(subName) {
  const c = getSubjectColor(subName);
  return `--sub-bg:${c.bg};--sub-border:${c.border};--sub-accent:${c.accent};--sub-text:${c.text};--sub-time:${c.time};`;
}

// 将来用：ユーザーが科目カテゴリをカスタム設定する関数
function setSubjectColorOverride(subName, category) {
  if (!subName) return;
  if (category) subjectColorOverrides[subName] = category;
  else delete subjectColorOverrides[subName];
  try { localStorage.setItem('nexa_sub_colors', JSON.stringify(subjectColorOverrides)); } catch(e) {}
  buildTT();
  if (currentTab === 'today') buildToday();
}

function sv(){
  try{localStorage.setItem('sp_cl',JSON.stringify(classes))}catch(e){}
  try{localStorage.setItem('sp_rt',JSON.stringify(routines))}catch(e){}
